home.heroTitle: An English learning CRM for TOEIC, IELTS, and online classes with measurable progress.
home.heroDescription: IVYTS combines packaged courses, mock tests, learning progress, and an internal inbox so students see a clear path, teachers track progress, and admins run things smoothly.
home.panelTitle: Students see the destination. Teachers see the progress.
home.panelDescription: From the landing page to the learning screen, the system focuses on what matters: picking a course at the right level, taking tests at the right time, and getting feedback from the right person.
home.feature1Title: A learning path with a clear goal
home.feature1Text: Every course is broken down by score band, skill, and checkpoint so students know what they're learning and why.
home.feature2Title: Mock tests tied to the roadmap
home.feature2Text: Students can take mini tests, practice sets, or free tests to track their TOEIC / IELTS level at each stage.
home.feature3Title: A CRM for running the classroom
home.feature3Text: Admins and teachers manage students, courses, messages, and content review in one system.
home.whyTitle: One system for learning and running the business
home.why1: Courses, lessons, mock tests, and progress come together into one clear English-learning journey.
home.why2: Teachers get their own workspace to track students, package lessons, and build tests for their class.
home.why3: Admins manage content review, users, messages, and operational metrics in one dashboard.
home.mockTestTitle: Tests that help students know where they stand
home.studyGuideTitle: Structured guides for studying TOEIC and IELTS
